note: Part 2 of the catalogue: Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Logic Apps, API Management, Relay, Notification Hubs and Data Factory.

types.label: Service Bus namespace
types.note: Basic (operations), Standard (base charge plus operations beyond the 13M included) and Premium (messaging units). Operations use the first paid volume tier, so the cheaper tiers above 100M operations are not applied. Brokered connections, geo-replication, Hybrid Connections and WCF Relay are not included.

inputs.label: Namespaces
inputs.help: Standard namespaces billed the monthly base charge.

inputs.label: Operations
inputs.help: Messaging operations a month, in millions. Standard includes the first 13 million.

inputs.label: Messaging units
inputs.help: Premium messaging units, billed per hour.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Service Bus' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

mu.free: Messaging units apply to Premium only.
Messaging units apply to Premium only.

base.free: Premium is billed per messaging unit.

types.label: Event Grid
types.note: Event Grid Standard operations (the first 100,000 a month are free; this prices the paid tier), MQTT operations and namespace throughput units. Custom topics and domains use the same operation price.

inputs.label: Event operations
inputs.help: Publish, delivery and management operations a month, in millions.

inputs.label: MQTT operations
inputs.help: MQTT publish and delivery operations a month, in millions.

inputs.label: Throughput units
inputs.help: Namespace throughput units, billed per hour.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Event Grid' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Event Hubs
types.note: Throughput units (Basic, Standard), processing units (Premium) or capacity units (Dedicated) per hour, plus ingress events on Basic and Standard. Capture, the Kafka endpoint, extended retention and geo-replication are not included.

inputs.label: Units
inputs.help: Throughput, processing or capacity units, billed per hour.

inputs.label: Ingress events
inputs.help: Events received a month, in millions (Basic and Standard).

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Event Hubs' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Logic Apps, Consumption
types.note: Pay per action: built-in, standard connector and enterprise connector actions. Data retention, integration accounts and the Integration Service Environment are not included.

inputs.label: Built-in actions
inputs.help: Built-in actions (HTTP, control flow) a month, in thousands.

inputs.label: Standard connector actions
inputs.help: Standard connector actions a month, in thousands.

inputs.label: Enterprise connector actions
inputs.help: Enterprise connector actions a month, in thousands.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Logic Apps' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Logic Apps, Standard (workflow plan)
types.note: Workflow Standard plan instances: vCPU and memory per hour. Storage, networking and connector charges outside the plan are not included.

inputs.label: Instances
inputs.help: Workflow plan instances running all month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Logic Apps' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: API Management (tiers billed per unit)
types.note: Gateway units per hour for Developer, Basic, Standard, Premium and the v2 tiers. Developer, Basic v2, Standard v2 and Premium (classic) use the prices in Prices & sources (the `apim-*` entries). Calls beyond the included amount on v2 tiers, secondary units, workspaces and self-hosted gateways are not included. Consumption is its own resource type.

inputs.label: Units
inputs.help: Gateway units, billed per hour.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'API Management' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: API Management, Consumption
types.note: Pay per call. Uses the `apim-consumption-calls` price, which is the first paid tier (after 1 million free calls).

inputs.label: Calls
inputs.help: API calls a month, in tens of thousands.

types.label: Azure Relay (Hybrid Connections)
types.note: Hybrid Connections listeners per hour and data above the included 5 GB. WCF Relay is a legacy offer and is not included.

inputs.label: Listeners
inputs.help: Hybrid Connections listeners, billed per hour.

inputs.label: Data transferred
inputs.help: Data sent through the relay a month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Service Bus' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Notification Hubs
types.note: Namespace charge and pushes beyond the included amount (first paid volume tier). The Availability Zones and Private Link options are not included.

inputs.label: Namespaces
inputs.help: Namespaces billed the monthly charge.

inputs.label: Pushes
inputs.help: Pushes a month, in millions.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Notification Hubs' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

unit.free: The Free tier has no charge.

pushes.free: The Free tier includes 1 million pushes.

types.label: Data Factory pipelines (v2)
types.note: Orchestration activity runs, data movement (DIU-hours) and pipeline activity hours by integration runtime. Read and write operations, monitoring operations, inactive pipelines, SSIS and mapping data flows (separate type) are not included.

inputs.label: Activity runs
inputs.help: Orchestration activity runs a month, in thousands.

inputs.label: Data movement
inputs.help: Data movement a month, in data integration unit-hours.

inputs.label: Pipeline activity
inputs.help: External and pipeline activity execution hours a month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Azure Data Factory v2' and armRegionName eq '{region}'

types.label: Data Factory mapping data flows
types.note: vCore-hours of data flow cluster time. Reserved capacity (1 and 3 years) exists for General Purpose and Compute Optimized and is not priced here.

inputs.label: Cluster time
inputs.help: Data flow compute a month, in vCore-hours (cores x hours the cluster runs).
